newsitem.title: USA: Grubb & Ellis gets $15 mln line of credit.
newsitem.headline: Grubb & Ellis gets $15 mln line of credit.

text.p: Grubb & Ellis Co, a commercial real estate firm, said Friday it has obtained a $15 million revolving line of credit from PNC Bank Corp.
A spokesman said the funds will be used for new initiatives, such as potential acquisitions, but will not be used to finance current daily operations.

Grubb & Ellis said it recently completed two common stock transactions that allowed the commercial real estate firm to eliminate its long-term debt. At September 1996, the company's debt stood at $28 million.
The company's shares were unchanged Friday at 7-1/2.
